subject: English

source.name: CISCE Curriculum for Classes I-V (English), Primary

notes: Process approach to writing (brainstorm→edit→rewrite). Cl IV has its own Literature list.

chapters.name: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Engage in discussions with teacher and peers
Report on a topic in an organized manner
Enjoy poems, songs, riddles, tongue twisters

chapters.name: Reading and Writing
subtopics: Read for comprehension; locate details and main idea
Infer meaning of unfamiliar words from context
Write at least two paragraphs (~150 words)
